Professor McNichols's lectures were super entertaining, but also really educational and helpful. Attendance is for credit, but you get full credit as long as you attend 80% of classes over the quarter.

Great professor, class is fun, it's just you have to come to lecture for guest speakers because the test will ask about what they talked about. And I've heard the course was harder than it used to be.
You'll reap what you sow with this course. Attend lectures, do the readings and you'll do well.

The textbook we use in class is one she wrote and is designed to meet you where you are regardless of your background and prior sex education. It was extremely helpful and you can't say that about most professors course materials here. The midterms and final are also open note.
It's an easy 4.0 and she's wildly entertaining.

I took this course online after the in-person section filled before I had a chance to register. After reaching out to Dr. McNichols and explaining the situation, she welcomed me to attend lectures and panels in-person so that I wouldn't miss that aspect of the course. She's extremely friendly and I enjoyed all aspects of the class.

Workload is very manageable and the tests are open-book/take-home, which I really appreciated as someone with awful testing anxiety. I highly recommend this class to anyone interested in the subject. It's an easy 5 stars from me. Trying to take her PSYCH 479 course next if my schedule allows for it.

I took PSYCH 210 after ALL of my friends who took it last year reccomended I do. 

I absolutely loved this class! Dr. McNichols is incredibly passionate about the subject, and it really shows through her engaging (and entertaining) lectures. She is freaking hilarous. It was a refreshing change from my other, more mundane STEM lectures.

Cons:
-you have to buy her poorly written $100 textbook
-Not a real psychology class, lots of course content is based on non-scholarly media articles.
-often shows students' names for "anonymous" personal questions on tophat
-skips slides
-she got political and went on a zionist rant

Pros:
-interesting and important subject matter
-easy

Required online textbook for $100. I feel that she cares more about boosting her social media presence. Attendance is mandatory. However, it is easy to succeed in this class so I'd recommend it if you want an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy class as long as you do the readings and go to the lectures. There is a required textbook and it costs around $100 which sort of sucks. Overall, a fairly easy but boring class.

Very unhelpful and short responses to questions outside of the Q&A section at the end of her Monday/Wednesday lectures, and the questions that get answered there are just whatever other students find funny. Also, the way she wants you to sign up for her newsletter feels cringy and overly self-promotional.

Prof. McNichols's stated goal is to normalize sex and sexuality, but she makes such a joke of everything that it ends up accomplishing the opposite. Additionally, she fundamentally does not understand how to talk about queerness and especially transness. Sometimes she'd have one of her TAs do those lectures and he was just so much better.

Charges $100 for a textbook that she wrote, with many claims not being backed up by any sort of cited sources. Requires use of student site that costs extra money and is not user friendly. Could easily use Canvas but has to squeeze extra money out of her students. Has the biggest ego out of any professor I have had at UW. Easy class, bad professor.
This guy takes attendance mandatory and gave you the attendance code halfway through the class which is awful.
She is narcissistically posting student faces all over the Internet in her social media, a FERPA violation, so report her to the university President.
She nationally invaded student privacy violated FERPA by plastering her students faces all over social media please report her to the school provost
She violated FERPA by posting her students face is all over social media somebody please report her to the school president

I honestly did not feel super safe/secure in this class. My therapist who actually has a degree in human sexuality shot down a lot of Nicole's unfounded claims. Also she has a tendency to oversimplify things to the point where some concepts are misconstrued. If you plan to take class, don't confuse her confidence for honesty.

Lectures are unnecessary, yet mandatory since she takes attendance. The textbook was more useful than the lecture. Took this autumn quarter. On the third exam, she purposefully tests you on videos watched in class to see if you were there. Just read and memorize the textbook and you will do fine on her exams.

Lectures are unnecessary, yet mandatory since she takes attendance. The textbook was more useful than the lectures. Took it Autumn quarter and she purposefully tests you on the videos referenced in class to see if you were there. Just read through and memorize the textbook and you will do fine on her exams.

Way to much work and attendance was mandatory. Class was only interesting for like one week, the rest of the time the lectures was long and monotonous. The professor barely showed up and charged crazy money for her text book where she kept the money. Do not takes this class if you value your time and money and grade.

Took this class to buffer a difficult STEM load and based on friends who enjoyed the class before. Was disappointed by how repetitive the lectures were of the readings when Prof. McNichols was actually teaching, but she missed a lot of her own lectures as it is and had a grad student teach for her. Temper your expectations. Not worth the hype.

Attendance mandatory for students but not the prof, who only taught maybe 1/3 of her own class. Grad student who took over/TAs did great. Note the $100 textbook she wrote and you have to buy outside course fee. Doesn't respond to email reasonably or want to engage with students. Cares about her social media/getting a book deal but not her teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. McNichols is a great professor and lecturer. The topics were super interesting, and I'd definitely recommend going into this class with an open mind. I took the course online so attendance wasn't mandatory. The exams had some tricky questions, but nothing crazy, especially if you attend lecture and do the readings.

This class content was interesting but I wasn't a huge fan of how it was presented. It's an easy A if you're willing to sit down and do homework / take notes for a good 3-4 hours once a week. Definitely good to take alongside several STEM classes.

Constant class cancellation. Lots of extra credit, but very exam heavy, and the details may contain small details in lecture. Attendance is mandatory, but doesn't show up half the time, and doesn't communicate it to students.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Good course for credit, but horrible prof. Attends two out of three lectures a week on top of cancelling class for a whole week, only tells us on day of class. TAs do heavy lifting and deal with office hours. Textbook costs $100 and isn't included in course fee. Might as well be asynchronous...

I guess people teach for different reasons...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Decent course, but have to study pretty hard for exams, minuscule details during lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment:
Easy class and I'd recommend it to anyone but professor quality is sketchy at best. Wrote the textbook but her degree isn't in human sexuality. Would be fine if she did research on the side but she doesn't. Lectures and the textbook are literally the same which makes class boring.

Easy 4.0 but if you're expecting quality, reduce your expectations.

Easy credit but god awful teacher. Major ego and terrible lectures. The content is pretty interesting for the first half of the quarter but she really fell off in the latter half. I feel Professor McNichols is only liked because she is pretty funny and social.

I loved this class, Dr.McNichols is very passionate about what she teaches she is super funny and entertaining. This class was a refresher from all my other boring lectures, I didn't mind that attendance was mandatory because it is a fun class to go to. Not too much homework and tests were open book. Highly recommend!!

psych 210 is probably the easiest course i've taken in UW. Her content is fun, however you do need to study for the test. The TopHat homework assignment is really helpful for understanding the concept. Overall i am glad that i have took this class, and i think i will use this knowledge for life.

Easy 5. If you're one of the people complaining about lecture content, idk what you were expecting. The class is the Psychology of Sex, and it covers a vast array of topics. I will note that this isn't a class for the close-minded. It's based on discussing sex, and many topics will be considered "taboo"/uncomfortable. Get over yourself.

I loved this class! I feel like the prof really understands the topic and tries to make the class as fun and open-minded as possible. What I didn't like was that she required attendance this quarter ?? and it is a 700 person class... she only gave us a 2 week buffer for attendance which meant ppl came to class sick all the time.

Too this class to balance out my STEM classes. Attendance was mandatory and counts for your grade. Required to pay for the textbook and homework through TopHat (About $100 dollars). Easily find homework answers on quizlet. Her exams are hard if you don't have friends in the class or have no notes. Overall, pretty ok class.

This is a VERY in-depth sex ed class, but professor McNichols made it comfortable! Attendance is required, but there is an attendance buffer to allow for some missed classes, so for most people it shouldn't be an issue. Tests are open-book, very easy. If you're close-minded or scared of uncomfortable topics, you wont like the class.

Kind and passionate professor, class was very overrated though. Some lectures were interesting but others were very boring. Lovely guest speakers sometimes though. Attendance mandatory but lectures just cover what was already read in the textbook. Tests are take home + open textbook and extremely easy. Tons of extra credit which is awesome.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved the class.

pt 2 from below: forgot to add but she makes u buy her textbook and a tophat subscription - over $100. stupid cause she cant use canvas like every other normal professor......also ngl kinda closed minded class - hot take furries should not be normalized - she begs to differ. anyway....easy 4.0
My only complaint is attendance is mandatory. Easy and interesting!

Everyone loves McNichols and this class and I'm no different. Super fun and interesting. The only drawback is that lectures are often not anything new after the textbook, but the panels and movies were good and it meant I could just show up to class and didn't have to take additional notes.

This class was so fun and I learned so much. Mon & Wed 2 hr lectures felt long but Nicole made it interesting with class questions and videos. Textbook was engaging but chapters were long. I read all the chapters but I'm sure you could get away with skimming since the tests are open book. Nicole's energy is amazing and she cares about us!

I would honestly say Professor McNichols is mildly overrated. Her class is fun and enjoyable, but I was hoping for a bit more of an engaging experience. I guess I should have expected this being in a 700 person lecture hall but I was a bit underwhelmed. I enjoyed the class and she was a great teacher, but not what I was expecting
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Pretty easy class, no need to go to lecture as she is just repeating things in the textbook. She is knowledgeable about the subject and you actually learn a lot of important things. The only downside to this class is that you are forced to pay for and use tophat ($100) for the homework and it is the worst platform and app ever created.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great Professor, super interesting lectures! If you have time I would totally recommend reading the textbook and attending the lectures because they're actually super cool and interesting. However, it's not really necessary. The tests are honestly pretty hard if you don't read the textbook and take notes, but there's a lot of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Does a really good job at going in-depth and explaining things in simple ways, tests are online and open not. She's also super considerate and caring. Lot's of reading but as long as you stay on task, it shouldn't take more than 90+ mins to finish.

The class was interesting for sure but I have to give a low rating because there were too many things I felt skeptical about. First, the textbook had an overwhelming amount of typos and misinformed summaries of many studies. Also, the textbook is not peer reviewed or not available for purchase for people outside of the class.

1. She does not wear a mask 2. Extremely disorganized and makes ZERO accommodations for her students ("I will not be answering questions from zoom participants nor will I be putting you into break-out rooms during time in class") 3. Poor communication. Class was canceled and we heard from another TA, not our dearest Nicole. Get a good group 4 hw
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Nicole is a good professor. Attendance isn't mandatory, as most of the information can be found in the textbook. There were a few questionable statistics used in the textbook, and some of the language used felt a bit isolating if you aren't straight/cis. But overall it was an interesting class and very easy to 4.0

McNichols is a goddess and deserves to be sung the highest praises. Her class is much more than a general sex-ed class and she is an engaging lecturer. Didn't go to class much considering that if you read the textbook, you're gold, but when I did, she was so entertaining and you can tell she's passionate about the topic she teaches and her students
Really good professor and interesting lectures. Easy A as long as you study a little for the exams. 10/10 recommend.

to be fair, i took the class online and couldn't attend the zoom lectures live. but mcnichols had a good energy and the content is not really difficult. it was definitely an easy A if you paid any attention at all. i imagine it would've been a little more fun in person though.
Shes so open and creates a wonderful classroom to learn and explore not just about the material but about who you are.
What a champ - made me figure out that I'm gay.

Graded on 3 exams and homework from tophat. The exams were fairly easy, but the material can sometimes trip you up and be on something random mentioned during lecture. The professor is also difficult to get a hold of through tophat (which is how she wanted us to contact her), but the class is interesting and the readings will have you intrigued
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor McNIchols's class is an easy A. There are lots of extra credit opportunities that make it easy to get a good grade. I rarely showed up to lecture but was still able to get a good grade. The course content was genuinely interesting and goes into much more than a sex-ed class.

She is a human incarnation of a goddess. I would take any class she taught no matter the subject matter. She truly cares for her students and the material and will work with you to help pass. Read the textbook and show up for class and you'll coarse through very easily. Cannot recommend her any more highly.

I loved Nicole!! She was so fun and always made the class super engaging. Loved all the polls she used to get data from the class and how she opened the last minute of class for q/a. Tests are open book/notes so they are pretty easy. Also lots of extra credit so an easy 4.0.

People aren't wrong, easy A. But the material reminds me of a 8th grade sex ed course, honestly a waste of tuition money and time. If you want to learn about the diversity of sexuality within psychology dont take this class. If you want an Easy A then do it. Teacher is really kind. Just be prepared to not be intellectually stimulated AT all.

I love this professor so much. She made my life so much easier this quarter and her class was so interesting. Don't listen to the bad reviews, she's amazing. She's very accommodating and the tests are really easy. Set reminders on your phone for homework and do the easy extra credit questions and you'll 4.0 this class.

the class was actually pretty interesting. there's an online textbook that has homework questions throughout along with three non-cumulative tests. it's all pretty easy and you learn some cool stuff you can actually bring with you in life. the teacher evaluation is extra credit and there's built-in room for missing assignments

Easy A. Do the class readings, take good notes, and you don't need to attend lectures. McNichols is super passionate as a professor. However, TopHat is a tricky system and the most finicky one I've used. Be patient and use Google Chrome. I wish I took her class in-person, which is the only thing that would've improved this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The class will give you what you put in, its pretty easy to get a good grade. However, Nicole uses Tophat which is the worst program I have ever used in my whole life- I'm not being sarcastic, Tophat will make you scream with how bad it works. The lectures are pretty interesting, but I cannot give higher than 3/5 because Tophat is death.

Just a fantastic professor who cares about her students. Wrote the textbook and made the exams open book, meaning all the answers were in the book so it was easy. Teaches very important info in a fun way that keeps students engaged. Easy A, super nice, great class.

She is really nice and the class is super interesting and easy. However, she is extremely disorganized and never knew where her slides were or what day review sessions were. She ended class early or came late multiple times and it didn't seem like she really cared about the class. That said, its a very interesting topic and was a fun DIV credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I've heard such good things about Professor McNichols, but I think she genuinely does not care about this class. She was late, disorganized, ended class early, and would find any reason to send you to breakout rooms. You have weekly group assignments which can be terrible with the wrong people. Read the textbook and take notes and you'll be fine!

Although Dr. McNichols definitely cares about her students, the class in general I thought was pretty dull and not at all engaging. All the info is in the textbook, so showing up to class doesn't matter, and the tests are super easy because she gives practice questions. Also TopHat is by far the worst online learning platform I have ever used.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: You can tell that Professor McNichols is very passionate and knowledgeable about her subject, and her lectures are very engaging. The three exams are non-cumulative, and weekly homework involves a bit of reading, but it is very doable. I really enjoy this class!

Great teacher and great topics. I loved this class and the subjects that were featured in the curriculum. The final grade consists of three tests each worth 30% and homework which is worth 10%. There's also a chance for extra credit by completing the end of course evaluation. Overall, this class is highly recommended.
Very nice and chill professor but also the class was easy so it would be hard to not be a good professor for the class.

Really enjoyed this course. Learned lots of information. There's a bit of reading but pretty manageable. The professor is open to answer just about any question. Exams are from lectures and textbooks. Overall, easy A and fun class.

Amazing. Nicole is so sweet, funny, and understanding. The class was not difficult at all and the information is definitely very useful for everyone to know. I would genuinely recommend everyone on earth take this class at some point in their life.
Interesting class and a great professor! We used an online textbook with InQuizative which I found to be frustrating, but the material went hand in hand with the lectures.
Amazing professor! However, make sure to keep up with readings and their due dates. It is easy to accidentally skip over a reading.

She's the best! One of the few professors that I felt actually cared about their students. Assignments are lots of readings but 100% manageable. Although lectures could get long, it covers important topics in the most entertaining way. Exams are fair as long as you do the readings/ assignments.
Nicole is a great professor! She's very knowledgeable and is very open to suggestions and corrections. This class itself is extremely fun and very informative.

Nicole is an amazing professor and woman! She is so inspiring and really loves her job. Its very clear that she cares deeply about her students! I would definitely recommend taking one of her classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Nicole is great. Her class covers topics you don't get to talk about anywhere else, and she's very knowledgeable on the content. She wants you to succeed, but more than that she wants you to learn something meaningful from her class. Lectures aren't super necessary because the tests mostly cover the textbook, but they're entertaining so show up!
If you have a chance, you have to take this class. It is incredible. The quarter just ended, and I already miss Nicole so much!!

Amazing professor who really cares about her students. The exams are multiple choice and open-textbook so you're pretty much guaranteed to get an A+. This class is about learning and being exposed to new perspectives, rather than cramming information for a test. Definitely worth taking this class.

Dr. McNichols was fun and the course content was interesting and engaging, but she seemed to struggle with the online format. Readings were long and mandatory but she often switched around due dates and so expectations weren't always clear. Tests were open note and very easy. Probably a great class in person, but I wouldn't recommend it online.

I love this lady! Synchronous lectures via Zoom that were engaging even from home, they were recorded so you could watch later if needed. Fun (optional) questions mid-lecture to keep you engaged, opportunities to ask questions anonymously. Online testing was easy and open notes, textbook questions were tedious but helpful. Great class!

The rumors are true! Dr. McNichols is as legendary as they say. Her class is inspirational, controversial, eye-opening, etc! It exposes you to a new side of human maturation that is often overlooked. Many students didn't give her the respect she deserves (probably b/c it was online this quarter). Please respect her and the content. Amazing prof!
Nicole is great. This is the first class I've ever really taken for myself and I am so glad I did.

This class was online because of COVID, however, I think despite her doing her best with the learning curve of online, I think this class would be better in person/prerecorded (not zoom). I learned the most purely from reading the textbook and barely attended the zoom. But, the class info was great to know and I would recommend. Tests were easy!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I love the class, and I love Dr. McNichols! Although there are so many things you need to read, you won't feel it at all because the content is very interesting. Exams are easy if you read through the textbook.

My favorite prof by far! You can tell she enjoys teaching and likes interacting with students. Tests fairly easy just make sure to read chapters especially on anatomy and you'll be golden. Genuinely looked forward to class every day during pandemic.

Professor McNichols genuinely cares about her students and offers interesting lectures. The topics she discussed about are applicable to real life situations and she would offer Q&A sessions occasionally for students to ask any questions they have. Exams are easy, minimal effort is needed if you pay attention to her lectures.

She is the best, definitely cares about her students and really enjoys teaching the subject. However when saying this is an easy 4.0, you need to work hard and read the material, otherwise, you won't do well. This class isn't curved so your performance will be based on how well you do the exams and homework. Otherwise an enjoyable class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She was a great professor! I absolutely loved her. I couldn't go to her office hours because I had another class, but she is definitely the type of teacher I want as a best friend. Super understanding of people's situations, and tries to make her lecture halls as fun and entertaining as possible.
Absolutely loved this class and the prof!! She was an absolute joy and I felt like she really cared about what she was teaching

Nicole is an amazing professor. This quarter she had to adapt to teaching online and despite of that, she still delivered and was very considerate of her students. Although she has 1200 students, she is very good at being accessible outside of class and is quick to answer her emails. She doesn't shy away from any questions and she is the sweetest!

Dr. McNichols is the most caring professor I have met so far. She has gone above and beyond to make sure she can eliminate any unnecessary stress during these uncertain times and you can tell she has a true heart to teach her students. The material in this class is extremely useful and she presents it in a great way. Dr. McNichols is the best.
hands down the best prof I have ever had. I've never had an instructor care about her students so much. If you ever have the chance TAKE HER CLASS.

Dr. McNichols is a saint. Her class is a must take, basically college sex-ed. She is engaging, caring, and informative. She has made the COVID transition almost seamless. This class fills fast, but if you can take it, DO IT. best I&S/ diversity class. truly cares about her students.

This professor is the best at UW. The class is so interesting and beneficial to life. I definitely went into class not expecting much and hoping to just get a good grade but this instructor changed me. Her lectures are so fun, never boring, and she really cares about you. Her sense of humor is top-notch. Not taking this class is waste.
A must take at UW and it counts as an I&S and diversity. If you are able to get in (it fills up in like 5 seconds on registration day) take it.

Exams are fairly easy if you do the readings. Lectures get a little dry at times (especially during the anatomy part), but you do get to learn a lot from this class. As long as you keep up with the readings, and take advantage of extra credit opportunities, this is a very easy 4.0.

A great, fun class. You learn so much useful information and Nicole is smart and nice. She does grade attendance so attend! Exams all multiple choice and I got an A just by attending class and taking notes. However, the online homework is tedious and the TAs grade the written homework arbitrarily. Not a fan of the TAs. But Nicole is great.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: While it's tempting to skip class - don't. It can get hilarious and it's just easier to learn the content by attending. In addition, this is a life-skills class - this knowledge is necessary to be a good person. TAKE IT.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I definitely love her. I took three classes with her. Her classes are not designed to be hard but you could learn a lot. She is sweet and nice. She is the best professor I have in UW I mean Who doesn't like her

McNichols really cares about her students and takes time out of class every day to answer student questions anonymously. She discusses important topics well and is a great lecturer. The only bad part about the class was the online textbook and homework being glitchy.
This is a great class/professor. You have to study a little for the tests but nothing crazy. Really interesting course that everyone should take!
Super intersting lectures and easy class. If you do the readings and pay attention in class it is an easy 4.0, she also offers a lot of extra credit.
Nicole is a fantastic teacher! And Psych 210 is a really fun and easy class to take, I'd highly recommend it!

I love Nicole so much. She's incredibly smart and sweet, and wants all her students to succeed, even in such a large lecture. I've learned so much in the class and she's made a big impact on my college life. (she's also super funny)

Nicole is one of the kindest and most approachable professor I have come across from my time at UW! She has made me laugh at least once in every lecture that I don't want to miss coming to lecture. Lecture attendance is graded, but not mandatory as she will go easy on grading for participation. If I could take her for every psych class, I would!

Nicole is the sweetest professor you could ever meet, dont get me wrong but her human sexuality class isnt the best. I took a few classes with her but this one due to the large lecture halls feels lonesome. The lecture 80% about anonymous dump questions. The exam is written in a vague psychological language which could be confusing and helpless

PSYCH 210 with McNichols is a must-take class at UW. She's hilarious, the class is hilarious because of the polling and unashamed pictures/videos, and you gain an understanding of sex that's much more complete and formal than the Internet.

Nicole is such an amazing teacher!!! After having teachers like Ann Culligan who grade your participation really harshly, it's really refreshing to have a teacher who grades participation fairly. Her lectures are truly engaging! She gives great examples and she is funny. She wants you to succeed :)

Professor McNichols is delightful. I think this is a class every college student should take. There is a lot of information but she didn't seem to care too much about grades but rather that students truly learn the material. She is also quite funny and careful with being inclusive and thoughtful with certain topics. Lots of extra credit too.

Lectures are super interesting and Nicole is super passionate about the subject. Attendance/participation is required (5% of grade, tracked via TopHat). This class is an easy one in terms of getting a 3.5+, but you still need to study. I ended up with a 4.0 but I also did all the homework, extra credit, and studied for each test a reasonable amount

Fun and engaging professor. Gives detailed study outlines for each exam- not cumulative. Wkly assignments from reading w/ table group, plenty class time to finish. One paper, but complete in steps throughout qrtr. Best of all, she readily seeks feedback and not afraid to chuck something that isn't working well. Truly wants her students to succeed.

This is a very fun class. There are three tests (including final) that are noncumulative. There's also readings about every week (hw). This class is easy if you come to class, do the homework, and study for the tests. Don't worry if you do badly on a test. There are a lot of extra credit opportunities to help your grade!

She's such a great professor and makes lectures extremely fun and easy to listen too. The textbook is super nice and easy to read, and she wrote it, which is super cool. 100% recommend taking this class, I truly enjoyed learning everything that was taught.

She is a great professor but she as a professor does not have great attendance in this class. Be prepared to watch a lot of videos, she has her grad students showing videos almost every Friday while she is absent, which can be annoying. Overall, She is a very nice professor but some of her lectures are boring or slow.
best prof ever, everyone in college needs to take this class. easy 4.0 and you learn a lot. also lots of extra credit chances

This class is incredibly easy to pass as long as you show up, do the homework, and maybe take notes on all bold words in the textbook. She gives out plenty of extra credit for taking surveys and her lectures are fun. I ended up with like 106% in the class and only spent maybe an hour studying for each exam. Go get that diversity credit.

I really enjoyed Dr. McNichols' course. She is extremely funny and a fantastic presenter, which made every lecture a treat. She also wrote the textbook, so there's no gaps between class content and the book (which itself is really good). The material she has selected for the class is diverse and engaging, while still a manageable workload.

This was the best class I took at UW. McNicoles is the best she's so genuine and funny and her lectures are never boring. The class is pretty easy as long as you show up and do the homework. The lectures are really interesting and I looked forward to them everyday. I would take this class again if I had time just for fun. McNicoles is the best.

This class literally blew my mind. Nicole provides clear and hilarious explanation of concepts. But be aware it's not an easy 4.0. Make sure you actually read everything on the textbook but not just answering the questions. Prepare to remember a lot of biological words and details. But overall, I would recommend this class to everyone.

Dr. McNichols was awesome. You get a "cheat sheet" for the tests which make them a lot easier. The class itself wasn't very hard if you keep up with the reading and participate in the in-class discussion. This class was very interesting and I will be looking into IO Psych for grad school because of it.
3 Exams and assignments. Attendance is mandatory. THIS CLASS IS NOT AN EASY "A"! the first exam out of 700 students, nobody got 100%.

She is super passionate about the subject matter and makes it really engaging. The lecture has an live anonymous chat where she answers very personal questions in a caring way but also reads through and goes a long with some funny joke answers to loosen the mood. Very fun class overall and an easy one too.
She was a fun professor and the class was easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: THIS PROFESSOR DESERVES AN AWARD!!! She is not only sweet, caring, and passionate about teaching, but she is willing to help you down to the nitty gritty. Come to class, get ready for fun group work, and to enjoy some laughs. Learned a lot about I/O in here.

This was one of my favorite class at UW! She's very passionate about what she teaches and it's makes the class a lot more interesting. You'll need to pay $80 for an online textbook though. OVERALL, she's very cute and amazing. She offers a lot of extra credit so I got a 4.0 in this class.
Her class is okay, lectures can kind of drag on though, and I wish she didn't rely so heavily on Youtube videos.

This professor has very engaging lectures that are hilarious and lighthearted. Although the class is test heavy, there is a lot of test materials on quizlet. This particular class is important knowledge regardless of your major, and is a good class for credits.

Super funny at times, lectures can feel slow, attendance is required and is taken twice per class, so you can't leave once you get bored. Tests are fairly easy and study guides are provided. If you like psych I would recommend her and the class, if not you might get bored.

She is amazing and cares so much about her students. She clearly loves the class and makes everyone else love it too. I wish I was a psych major who could take more classes with her. If you are reading this Nicole, I LOVE YOU!

Nicole was a fine professor. She's very caring and enthusiastic, and she's dedicated to the subject. The course was very easy, and is largely review if you have much sex ed or social education. She's not going to be your favorite professor of all time, but I can't give a reason not to take one of her courses. A very nice lady.

One of the must-takes at UW. It's the essential Sex Ed you won't get anywhere else. McNichols' lectures are highly organized, and have interesting survey questions. She also gives extra credits up to 0.5 GPA points. She also wrote the textbook, and I enjoy reading it. The content is concise and relevant. Highly, highly recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Nicole is an amazing lecturer, professor, and person. You can really tell how much she cares about her students. The class is pretty easy and straightforward--has so much extra credit opportunities and the content is super interesting too! My only suggestion would be to make the lectures every day for 50 mins so people can be more engaged in class.

McNichols is SO hilarious - she makes classes entertaining and shock value topics not awkward to learn, it's really the sex ed I've never learned from my parents. She also wrote the textbook so she knows her stuff. In my opinion, it's very easy to cram the night before and do well on tests, the amount of extra credit is also INSANE! Would recommend

get ready for an easy class that involves some of the biggest shock value. 3 non cumulative midterms that are pretty easy. homework take about 30 min a week. take advantage of the extra credit because she gives a lot (up to extra .5 boost in your gpa)

McNichols is a true goddess. She made the class fun and not awkward at all, but very very interesting. She's excellent at teaching to a large group, and she wrote the interactive online textbook, so it follows lecture perfectly. The readings are reasonable, tests aren't bad at all, and there are lots of extra credit opportunities.

I thought this class was supposed to be more fun. The contents actually were kind of interesting, but her lectures were not so great. She speaks incredibly fast and sometimes just doesn't explain terminologies which can be super confusing to non-native speakers because she always assumes you already knew those things.

I loved Dr. McNIchols and her style of teaching. The lectures can get a little boring but being there for class participation is a big part of your grade. The material on the tests is literally in her slides. She is passionate, compassionate, and a blessing to the UW psych department.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: With many extra credit options, this class is not so tough. Go to lectures and review the slides before exams and you'll be fine. The exams are not really detail-oriented, but you should spend quite some time before each exams. In my quarter, the lowest exam is dropped so I didn't have to take the final! - Best part of this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. McNichols was one of my favorite teachers from the Psych Department at UW. She came to class excited and ready to teach every time. Her homework guidelines were easy to understand, and if you had any questions she would respond in a timely manner. Take her class! This I/O class really prepared me for my field of work after graduating!

Dr. McNichols is the rare combination of incredibly well-educated and versed, yet humble and kind. Although the long lectures can be a tough, she is always there to clarify any concepts you don't understand and very obviously cares about her students. This class takes hushed or taboo topics and encourages students to explore their preconceptions.

Dr. McNichols is among the most adored psych profs at UW by psych majors, and she's my favorite prof of all time. If you care about the class content at all, take her. In class, she used engaging jokes, demos, and stories to help you understand, apply, and remember complex content. She prioritizes your deep learning AND wellbeing. She's the best!

McNichols is incredibly invested in making sure students both learn and enjoy the course. She is there literally anytime you need her and is very generous with her time, help, and grading! Really, as long as you listen during lecture and take notes, you should have no struggles in this course. Highly recommend!

The content of this class is somewhat interesting but as the class itself, the presentations can be boring and like someone said a hit or a miss. The tests are incredibly vague and have multiple answers of similarity and sometimes don't make sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. McNichol's is wonderful! You can tell that she absolutely loves her job and she makes her class so interesting. There are lots of panels and videos and although her class has participation, its fun! I wish I could take this class again.

Dr McNichols is the kind of professor who is passionate about what she teaches, and really cares about her students' success. She's very approachable, kind and funny, creating a great lecture environment. She's available outside class and always happy to provide extra explanation if you are struggling with a concept.

Don't need book. Memorize slides for tests. Clarify poorly worded questions if confused, she will help. So much extra credit available if you check the website regularly. Go to class even though she reads off slides. Interesting participation platforms, panels, and perspectives. She's SO kind; feels like your friend's mom. Worth the long lectures.

PSYCH 210 was overall a super easy class. The tests could be a little specific but there was basically no work involved. The lectures were hit or miss, sometimes they were interesting and other times they were vague and uninformative. Also, be aware that we watched very explicit videos in class on multiple occasions.

McNichols is a nice professor who cares about her students. Lectures include polling questions so attendance is a must. Lectures are very heavy and she tends to read off the slides a lot. Weekly discussion questions. Not much goes in the grade book. Many extra credit chances. Don't need the textbook. Lots of information, hours of studying required.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Class is interesting and I enjoyed the panels a lot. Class is easy- multiple choice tests, hw  is posting/answering questions online weekly. I didn't find the professor's lecturing style engaging at all- she read directly from the slides, making the two hour lecture crawl by and often mixed up words. She could have made material interesting
She gives lots of extra credit and if you do all of the participation and show up to lectures and give more than half of your effort on tests, you'll do well!

Love her class, one of the best I've ever taken. At least half of class is spent discussing the material in small groups, not listening to a lecture. If you do the readings, you will learn this material easier and better than any lecture you've ever had. She's super nice and loves to hear your ideas. Genuinely wants her students to enjoy learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: A really sweet woman. She always made me happy. The class is easy and interesting, obviously, since it's about sex. The panels are also super inspiring and eye opening. There are a couple questions out of the textbook but most of the test material comes from lecture.
Material and tests were not too hard. But her writing assignments are not easy.

She is a great lecturer and she truly cares about students. This class has a relaxing setting, and you will learn a lot if you pay attention. Although she goes through the material pretty fast, slides are posted online and she is always up for questions. Highly recommended! (Especially if you are a STEM major and want chill classes)

Dr. McNichols was so awesome to have! She was fair, unbiased, honest, and very witty with her lectures. Even though attendance is definitely not mandatory, there are TopHat questions every class that contribute to a participation grade. However, you can follow the TopHat lecture and questions from home. Highly recommend! Also a great class to take.

Professor McNichols presented class material maturely and concisely. The class itself is extremely easy, but I don't imagine she has much control over what the department wants her to teach. All things considered, I enjoyed coming to class each day and appreciated the professionalism with which she taught the course.

This class was too easy largely because it isn't a science or psych class. It's, more or less, a high school sex-ed class on roids. So many times in lecture I heard speculation instead of scientifically backed statements. THIS ISN'T A WEAKNESS OF THE INSTRUCTOR, it's the nature of diversity classes.
Lecture is long and her teaching is a little bit disorganized. Contents are interesting but lots of typos in slides. Since it's a class full of terminology, those typos are very confusing.

She is a super friendly professor and really cares about your education.  If you need help on anything, she is available to discuss with you. The content from the lectures were really interesting, but some of the articles were a bit long.
This class makes me never wanna take a psychology class again. Have to do S/NS at the end.

She's nice but not very organized or well versed with the clicker system (TopHat). The lectures and assigned readings didn't match up very well and it seems like very little information is used from the book. She's pretty easy but the class is really boring because she's not very good at lecturing

Very interesting class but McNichols seems to get frazzled very easily, whether that be from struggling with using TopHat or confusing key points of information. Lectures seem very long and too much time is spent on simple information or self-explanatory ideas.

She's really nice, pretty good at lecturing, and the class was really easy. The only thing I didn't like was that a lot of the material was already covered in psych 101, and going over stuff you already know is boring.

It's a team-based class so get ready to do group assignments. The assignments are not tough; go to class otherwise you have to do the assignments on your own. My one issue is the textbook. Tests were based off of the 11th edition yet the syllabus said the 10th edition. She clearly had issues addressing this and didn't do much to help.

Best class I have ever taken in the psychology department.  This is a team based class, so with a great team, you will have a great time in the class. Very lenient with grading papers as well.  I would definitely take another class with her again if I can!

I loved Mrs. McNichols. She was a great lecturer and very sweet, and she genuinely cared about how you were doing in the class. Definitely get ready to memorize for the tests even though they were only multiple choice. This class isn't as effortless as a lot of people make it seem!
I learned a lot in her class. She had clear expectations and was a fair grader. I would definitely recommend her.

One of the best classes I have ever taken as a psychology major at the University.  McNichols is one of the most kindest professors I have ever met.  In PSYCH 445, it was a team based class, where students discussed amongst team members about assigned articles. She encourages students to participates and clears up misunderstandings quite well.

She's alright! She mostly lectures near the computer though. Make sure you read the articles and do practice tests! The tests involve so much memorization so just reviewing the slides is not going to cut it. Go to the review session, do extra credit, and retake your tests! You won't regret it. I jumped from 2.6 to a 3.8 after retakes

Great professor! She was super sweet and all of the tests are curved (she even adds points to your score!) A lot of material to remember, but allows chance to make up tests on final day. Overall, just study for the tests and you can get a pretty decent grade in the class.

Awesome teacher. Really cool, young and interesting. However, PSYCH 210 itself is one of the hardest "easiest" classes you could take. I study my ass off for the tests and right now I'm at a 2.9. Theres an enormous amount of material covered. Strongly recommend not taking this class. GPA killer!

Great Professor! Easy to approach, gives great examples.The class was very interesting, especially since the professor went above and beyond to make it so. If you attend every lecture and study them sufficiently- you will do good in the class.
GREAT professor, great person. Definitely take this class!!

One of the most caring professor and person I have ever seen. She deeply cares about how much you've learnt in class and your difficulties. I couldn't have wished a better professor. Very clear explanations with interesting examples like Twilight...She is just wonderful. A Must take!

It was her first quarter teaching but the material was super interesting and Professor McNichols was really nice and really tried hard to make class fun/interesting. She really knows what's up but needs to be more confident in herself. Loved this class and really recommend it :)

I don't get the low rating for Marko! His lectures were engaging and fun, and also very helpful on teaching the content. But attendance isn't required and you can get a lot of the info from the slides and recordings as well.

this class is an easier version of ap stats. the lectures were a bit boring because i knew all of the information, but the prof was nice and i found him to be pretty funny. quizzes and exams are just like the practice ones he gives. the team activities did seem a bit pointless though, but they were easy and nothing to really worry about.

you get the grade that you put in the effort for. basically AP stats, but grading system can be annoying if you lose points early on. truly dont understand the bad reviews, he is helpful and tries his best to be funny and engaging. practice exams are basically same as actual exams, and he allows cheat sheets

His lectures are not engaging and they don't help much with the homework. The lectures are recorded, but don't get posted until 1 week before the exam so if you miss something, you're going to have to wait a while to go back to watch it.

Great professor... don't really understand the negative reviews. His exams/quizzes are super similar to the practice exams/quizzes. You are also allowed notes sheets on which as long as you have the correct formulas it's really hard to get the problems wrong because they are almost always formulaic problems and not conceptual.

I think Marko is a great guy, however hes not the best lecturer. I did not find his lecturing style where he goes straight from slides helpful. He also gatekeeps the lectures until a week before an exam which sucks.

Professor was amazing and had a great sense of humor. I do not understand where all of the negatives reviews come from. As long as you show up to lectures and do the required homework assignments you will be just fine for quizzes and exams. Hard to get a 4.0 in this class but easy 3.0+.

Marko's not as bad as the reviews make him out to be. He seems to genuinely care about us and how we perform in the class. Most of the content I learned in HS, but if you don't alr know it, there's lots of resources to help you. This class is very doable imo.

To be completely honest, the professor himself was not awful but the way he set up the class was rough. The class concepts were not engaging and the grading scale is so bad. Every 14.9 points you get marked off is 0.1 off your GPA, but each question is worth so many points so if you get one question wrong your grade is guaranteed to drop.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't waste your time taking his class, not worth his obnoxiousness.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's an extremely understanding and caring professor. The class is test-heavy, but the questions are pretty straightforward. As long as you create a good cheat sheet, you'll do well.

This professor is the funniest professor I have ever had. Great use of humor to keep students engaged and make concepts memorable. Doesn't allow computers in class which worked better than I thought. Great with interacting with students during class. One of the few professors that I don't think is here just for research purposes.

UPDATE: I PASSED AYE. This was actually my lowest grade I've received at foster (2.0). I am very devastated cuz I did try, but I can tell you that if you're good with math and have an analytical brain I can see how you could do not bad. Not everyone will snuggle the same way, but plz use ur resources! FIT and office hours. It's not the worst class!
Lecture material isn't super helpful when it comes to the homework or quizzes. Just do some research and studying from outside sources and you'll be good. Not as hard as everyone else says it is.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: When I took the class, he wanted us to use paper instead of our computers, so I printed out every lecture although he didn't enforce that later on. The worst part of the class was the quiz section, that had quizzes every other week, and group projects on the opposite weeks where nobody understood what they were doing. Cheat sheet allowed sometimes.
very quiz + exam heavy class, but marco teaches well! really funny and accessible outside class; material is tough but as long as you put the effort in ull be fine
Marco is great at what he does. I went to his office hours, and he answered all my questions perfectly. That helped with loads of the HW answers I would have gotten incorrect on.

This class wrecked me emotionally fr, if you fall behind even briefly, it's hard to recover. I went to tutoring 3x a week, never missed lecture, studied weekly, and still struggled. It's not impossible, but if math isn't your strength, good luck. Marko's not bad, it's just tough. my is Final's soon—wish me luck, I'll update after.

Recommends the book but, I didn't read it. Overcomplicated easy concepts, tried to trick you in the exams, & left out important things to know. Every other quiz section is either a group quiz or individual quiz. Kinda pointless tbh. Quizes were fine, and HW did too much. I did okay cuz I self-taught. Office hours with him=not helpful. Gook luck (:
Worst professor I have had in my entire life! He is just there to talk and make money, does not care about if students are learning. No passion or anything.

This teacher will do everything in his power to make sure that you can't succeed unless you go to every single lecture. Not sure why attendance is so important to him, only course in the entire foster pre-reqs that seems to actually care about attendance more than students learning. He also grades super harshly. Don't take this class.
Do yourself a favor and do not take this class.
Class was awful; tests and quizzes are significantly more difficult than given course materials. Be sure not to miss any lectures, and his teaching style consists of in-person examples.
Please don't take this class. To get a 4.0 you can only miss 14.9 points out of ~550 in the ENTIRE course. He also is very unaccomodating regarding deadlines.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS
Took this class last quarter, I feel like Marko gets unnecessary hate. He is very nice and funny, the practice homework and exams are perfect preparation for the midterm and final.
Jesus I haven't had such a terrible professor since middle school, do not take him
Awful professor, I wanna drop the class so bad but I don't think any other professor teaches it. Genuinely the worst classes I've taken and Marko makes it 10x worse
Awful professor, I would not take him again or advise any of my peers to. For my foster students out there, just take stat 311 with a different professor.
The last two reviews below this were definitely written by him. All I have to say is that he is very boring and not helpful to students. I would recommend taking stat 311 instead of qmeth with marko.

He honestly is a great professor. The class itself is tough but as long as you study and focus in lectures you'll do well. Make sure to stay up to date with the topics being used and do the practice problems from lecture to gain a better understanding.

Yes, he grades harshly, yes the class is hard.
But it's not that hard to work. He always answered Q's in office hours, he always asked students to participate and made jokes. So much unneeded hate for a prof teaching a moderately hard course. Read textbook, go to lectures, ask him questions, and study. It's not impossible.
No passion, it's like he is there just for a paycheck. I get it is a boring class but at least be responsive to students and try to help. Would not recommend taking him.
Do NOT take him. He makes exams and quizzes extremely hard. He also never responds to emails. He also doesn't take questions during lecture to top it off.
I don't know a single person in his class that showed any form of liking to him. Horrible professor, would NOT recommend taking him ever.
Genuinely worst professor I've had in all my 20 years of life on earth. I hope he gets fired
wish I could've withdrew, go on Khan academy!!!! only way to pass. save your mental health.
Genuinely the WORST professor in all of UW.

Picture this: your parents are going through a divorce while you are taking this course and it affects your mental being so you can't keep up with the class.

Then you take the midterm because the tuition was alr paid for. You get the worst score ever and he posts everyones scores on the test to the whole class

This is the kind of professor he is.
I literally had to drop, I need to retake this class next quarter. I'm not happy; wish me luck.
no comment.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Boring lecture. Very boring. He talks about one question for the whole lecture time, which can be done in 20 mins max. Keeps on repeating the same thing the whole lecture, honestly way faster to watch the recording and skip through most of the class. Class is not hard, just boring and too slow paced.

The class does not require a textbook even though he says it's mandatory. He doesn't allow computers in class which is frustrating especially if you already know the material and don't need to pay attention 100% of the time. Just bring an iPad if possible and take notes. Study before exams and you should do fine. Group projects are poorly set up.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Madunic wasn't great, but he really isn't terrible, either. Make sure to pay attention while he demonstrates how to solve a problem. You can miss a lot of easy points on homework and quizzes, so be careful. He also doesn't pace himself well during lectures, so they can be too rushed or slow. Read the textbook and you'll be fine.

He is a tough grader and grade is only based on a few assignments including the midterm and final. Lectures felt very rushed and towards the end some lectures had to be recorded due to lectures not being finished before the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would recommend taking this class at a CC. The lectures are long and boring and often don't make sense. The material is already hard and the way he teaches it just makes it worse. He is a nice guy but this class is brutal and he does nothing to help your grade. Don't take this unless you want to ruin your GPA.

It wasn't bad, but it wasn't good. He consistently canceled his office hours, which was annoying. Most of his tests and quizzes had questions from previous years. Overall, he's a nice guy but could've taught the course better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Marko has a bad rep because the class is so difficult. He's a decent guy who teaches an absolutely brutal class. The TAs are useless and don't help. The practice exams are huge, use those. But take at a CC if you can to save your GPA.

Madunic allows you to have cheat sheets on every quiz and exam. While this is great because you don't need to memorize formulas, it means that everyone does well on tests, and the curve ends up hurting you. Divide and conquer for team activities during quiz sections to finish on time. Homework and team activities are graded on accuracy.

Genuinely my worst experience with a professor so far. Lectures feel rushed, quiz sections are utterly useless, and it is clear that the students' time is not respected. If you can find a way to take this class without Marko, do it. Every little thing about this class and its structure drives me insane.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS TEACHER! He doesn't teach. He just reads off his slides at supersonic spead and you're suppose to understand. I taught myself everything without reading the textbook and had a 93% (including quizzes and assignments) until I took the midterm which was NOTHING like the practice. TAKE THROUGH COMMUNITY COLLEGE ONLINE!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Marko may be kind at first but his course structure and policies will make you realize he is the spawn of the devil. Do not take him if you value your happiness.

Decent lecturer, but you NEED to read the textbook before class to understand anything. Attending his office hours is a must for completing the homework. The quizzes and final were fine, but the midterm was really hard. No electronics in class, which was annoying. Also, class recordings and lecture slides were posted infrequently.

Marko was not my ideal professor.

My ideal professor is one that doesn't absolutely humiliate you for asking a question.

That makes nobody want to speak or interact with them.

Incredibly ineffective lecturer, and does not post annotated slides until days or weeks later, which makes teaching yourself tricky. Every single assignment is graded, and it does not feel like you have time to learn the material and make mistakes before it reflects on your grade. Office hours and the TA were also unhelpful.

Class sucked. Madunic is not a good teacher and you have to go to class because lectures/lecture notes are not accessible online. Homework, quizzes, and group assignments are way easier than tests which makes the tests miserable. Also, you can only write notes on paper no electronic use allowed in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor at uw

Horrible professor. Does not listen carefully to students when asked questions. Can be very rude sometimes when having 1 on 1 talks. Takes very long to respond to emails. Overall one of the worst teachers I've had. Only take him if you have to and there are no other professors.

Teaching style needs improvement. Often difficult to follow the main points as he can't stick to it himself and often rambles off to something irrelevant.
In my experience, this was one of the more challenging/poor quality classes I've taken at Foster. I'd say stay away but he was the only professor offering QMETH 201 for the quarter...

never gives proper definitions and explanations for any concepts, he spends most of his time talking about irrelevant real-world situations that make the content 10x more confusing. have to go to useless lectures to see the answers to example problems because he only posts recorded lectures and answers to class problems 2 days before an exam >:(

I disagree with his tests being easy to study for. Usually practice exams alone are enough for me to get 4.0's in classes, but not this one. The actual midterm was so different from the single practice exam he gave, I'm not even sure what/how to study for the final.

He is a nice professor. A lot of his lectures were long and I usually had to go look back over my notes to understand what we did in class. He can be very confusing at times, I learned to go to TAs for hw help instead of asking him.

Marko gets a lot of bad reviews but he's really not that bad. He is very caring and will explain things if you're confused. TA's are worthless and are unable to help you, study for everything and you will do fine. You'll only do poorly if you get behind or don't try.

The best way to take notes was by hand, but he went so quickly through the slides it was difficult to keep up. As someone who has not taken a stats course before, I only managed to stay on top of things by looking up explanations on YouTube and going to OH. Luckily, tests are easy to study for (practice quizzes/problems) and the prof is helpful.

Nice and approachable guy, but his teaching style sucks. Expects you to print 20 page slides once or twice a week to take notes on in class. It's $2 for one packet. He speeds through content, leaving behind people who don't have the slides printed and need to copy. Also is just really fast in general. Sections are hilariously useless but mandatory.

Goes very fast but content is not hard. Second half of quarter gets pretty intense because you get a lot of content mixed up but he's very willing to explain things outside of class. Quiz sections are kind of a joke but you need to go for participation. Overall tests were pretty predictable
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: nice guy tries hard but not the best teacher. Doesn't call on you in class and spends too much time covering not important topics. Expects you to memorize formulas the first time you see them.

Tests were very easy so the class has a high curve. I didn't like his lectures very much and he has a tendency to dismiss students when they try to participate in class. Since this class is for business students there is no theory, he just throws a bunch of unintuitive formulas at you. Quiz sections are pointless. Would not take him again.
Prof. Madunic goes over lectures too fast and includes material that was briefly mentioned in the final exams, expecting us to remember.

I feel like prof Marko gets a bad review. I disagree with every other opinon. You need to go out of your way, attend OH, ask questions, and participate to get the grade you want. These 3 will help you alot. He is very willing to help and will teach you how to do it rather then give you the answer but you need to reach out for it. Best prof so far.
he is just a bad professor
rude asf. makes you feel dumb when you ask a question.

He is over-hated. His lectures are clear and concepts are not too hard. Exams were SO EASY. Group activities are dumb and make your grade suffer. He let me take the exam 3 days after everyone else cause I had two exams on one day and he didn't want me to be too tired. Gave me major/career advice too. Curve is bad tho, I got 95.5, that's a 3.8.

Marko's a cool dude, OH are where it's at. Lectures aren't necessary to do well. He doesn't allow electronics in class unless you have DRS accommodations. Formula sheet (front and back) for quizzes and exams (2 full pages for final). Group activities during quiz section were dumb though. Also his accent makes it hard to understand him sometimes.

Honestly, he gets a worse rep than he deserves. Marko comes across as knowledgeable about the topic and goes into good detail. Every quiz section was either a graded project or quiz, which sucked. Tests and quizzes weren't too hard and homework was reasonable. Textbook definitely not required, despite it technically being part of the class.

Marko is a decent instructor but the class was quite difficult. His explanation during lecture wasn't clear and made things more confusing than it needed to be. Quiz sections are composed of excel assignments and group work which isn't useful at all. Quizzes were within reasonable difficulty but exams are tough. Khan academy will be your bestfriend

Instead of going over certain problems by writing them out, he would show the solutions next slide, explain them in a very hard way to understand, and repeat all problems. If you are not caught up, you will need to rewatch the lectures online to fully understand the concepts.

this class was very difficult but not impossible. professor madunic was very helpful and willing to help his students as much as possible. quizzes were good reflections of the content but the exams were extremely difficult. if you put the effort in learning the content in the content the class isn't that bad but the curve is absolutely terrible.
the class is boring but tough. the grading is harsh on exams and quizzes. the final grade is horrible too (curved down afaik). only positive thing: prof. Madunic is willing to help over emails
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took AP stats the previous year so that helped me a lot. His lectures can get boring and he goes slow on less important stuff and fast on stuff you want to take notes on. I would rewatch the lectures (1 hr per lecture)! He is a really nice and understanding guy. All quizzes and exams get a cheat sheet which make them so easy and not as stressful.
Lectures were online so only had to attend quiz sections once a week. Very nice but class was very difficult.

Prof Madunic clearly cares about his students. One of the nicest Foster profs I've met. His lectures can be a bit confusing, but if you apporach him, he will devote time to actually help you. He wants his students to succeeed and tries hard to ensure that. It was a hard class for me but his tutoring got me and my friends through it. Great guy.

He such a harsh grader.. I understood the criteria very well but did poor in the class only because he grades so harshly on exams and quizzes. Also, the curve in the class is non existent.. avoid this teacher at all costs!

Honestly Marko gets a much worse reputation than he deserves. Hes a wonderful guy and is always willing to help his students, which is nice when his material can sometimes be difficult to pick up. His class doesnt have a lot of points to get, but its an easy A if you engage in the work.

Marko's lectures tended to be rushed in the end (crammed a lot of material before quizzes and exams), so be sure to read the textbook beforehand and take notes before the lecture. He was really good with email, helpful during office hours, and wanted people to succeed. Not a challenging course if you put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Although unpopular, I found the class to be reasonable. As mentioned, it's a difficult class but if you put in the work, you'll do well. Curved to a 3.1.

The problem with this class is that you will not learn anything from Marko. He knows what he's talking about, but unfortunately, YOU won't know what he's talking about - he is not a very good teacher. This means that anyone with AP Stats experience will slaughter the class and run the top quiz scores, resulting in the WORST curve I have seen at UW.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Marko is actually a solid choice for stats. While the structure of the class may not be the usual of reviewing concepts in quiz sections, Professor Marko is always to explain/answer questions during his office hours. His lectures are confusing at first, but the practice problems really help. Overall, not a bad choice for stats!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: I don't know why the other reviews are so negative. My experience with Marko has been nothing but positive thus far. His lectures aren't the most fun, but definitely clear and you get everything you need from the lectures. He was flexible when I forgot to turn in assignments, and gave good clarification through email. He is a kind, great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Concepts are not too hard, tests are absurd. No asynchronous option for quiz sections, and offers little flexibility. Severely unorganized - told us to submit our work for credit after our quiz sessions ended, but mine ended late and the assignment had closed. Emailed it in, and while it was accepted, was told it was my fault and no more leniency.

I have really enjoyed my time in this class. He makes the material pretty easy to understand, and is super patient when answering questions. Overall, he is a pretty solid choice for qmeth201. I don't recommend skipping class, you'll miss out on the practice problems that give better understanding. He's kind of a slow grader though

He is NOT a good professor, lectures are long, all over the place. There are a few quizzes, midterm, and final. He does not give you anything to prepare for the tests, which is so annoying because you can study one thing, but then the test looks completely different. If you can, please try to take this class with someone else.
This class was somehow a bigger disaster than the 2021 UW basketball team. Poor lectures, confusing course material, and very unorganized. Avoid Marko.

Avoid him if you can. He teaches out of the textbook, and it's like having text-to-speech reading you the textbook every lecture. Homework is graded on accuracy, and he doesn't go that deep into the topics in class, so office hours are a must if you want a clue as of what to do. I wish this wasn't mandatory for Fosters, but it is.

This class is well presented and organized. Lectures are great, with ample explanation of course content and walkthrough of relevant practice problems. While initially hard, quizzes and exams become easy by doing his recommended textbook problem sets and his practice exams. He is easy to access and helpful outside of class during office hours.

There is so much studying by yourself if you want to do well in the class so definitely get the book. Marko will only teach you the basics and expects you to be an expert by the time of the test. Probably gonna be the first failed class. Great person, terrible teacher

By far the worst professor I've ever had. Head and shoulders above the next hardest class I've taken. It's not even that statistics as a course topic was difficult, it was Marko's way of teaching. He's a very smart individual but does not know how to teach. Quiz sections were absolutely useless for what you are going to end up being tested on.

DO NOT TAKE ANY CLASS WITH MARKO. Lectures are unorganized, confusing, and rushed. You will have to teach yourself all course content but it doesn't even matter because he will throw curveballs on the quizzes. Seriously it is shameful of Foster to have such a class taught this way while students are PAYING for it. Avoid at all costs.

I am a very patient person and tried to give Marko the benefit of the doubt, but he only inhibited my learning. The content isn't hard, but his lack of organization, refusal to answer questions, and hours wasted avoiding the true content in lecture is what made the course hard. Be ready to teach yourself, because quiz section is a waste as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor I've ever had at UW. Marko doesn't provide any in depth explanations of the material and expects students to understand while providing confusing and complicated material that is extremely difficult. Quiz sections are just tests and useless activities. Even the best students do poorly in this class, avoid like the plague.

This class is easily the most frustrating, inconsistent course I've taken at UW. The homework submissions times change weekly and are graded on correctness (only one submission). Marko brushes over lecture examples with minimal explanation and displays all of the previously written work at one time. Even Khan Academy can't save you :/
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I really wanted to like Marko, but I simply could not. He is confusing, contradictory, and doesn't focus on the important information which made me feel lost during all the lectures. This is the only class which I have ever thought I might fail, even though I studied an above-average amount. The first couple of quizzes caught me entirely off guard!

This class  definition of a horror show. Lectures were so unorganized; most of the important material would never be taught. There are no opportunities to review in the quiz section because of the activities and quizzes; be prepared to learn yourself. To top it all off, any time a question is asked, he just tells you to attend office hours. WOW!

One of the worst professors I have ever had, if not the worst. Confusing lectures, unorganized, useless quiz sections. For a class that is already confusing enough, Marko makes it so much worse. Very sad that Marko is associated with Foster.

Marko is hands down the worst professor I've had at UW and honestly one of the worst teachers I've ever had, period. He is extremely unorganized, a poor communicator, and doesn't provide students with extra practice outside of lectures and hw. He is truly a disgrace to this University and definitely a disgrace to Foster. Avoid him at all costs.

Avoid Marko at all costs, it is a shame for the Foster School of Business to have this professor teach here. He reads out of the book, doesn't provide insightful information, and was a waste of my tuition money. I didn't learn anything valuable in this class and I tried my best, I understand that we are in COVID-19, but this is a shame.
she's SO nice omg. genuinely cares about her students and wants you to learn and succeed in her class. would definitely recommend.
Good lectures, clear instructions, lots of resources

Agree that a lot of mistakes are made, but I found Prof Naehrig to be generous with grading, and the content for tests are very clear. Definitely need to study to do well and watch lectures on time but she does a wonderful job teaching the course content.

Super nice and caring professor. Tried a new system this quarter with retakes, so that was nice - don't know if she will continue.

There are a significant amount of assignments but as long as you keep pace with the course, you will get a 4.0.
