Very disorganized lectures, no recordings provided, badly handwritten notes posted after class. He's not the worst, but I understanding the content only from the class materials was challenging (outside sources recommended). Not recommended if u don't test well since the class had 2 midterms (20% each) and one final 40% of your grade.
The GOAT.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Accessible outside of the class, and always explained concepts I was confused about clearly and easily to understand. Also was hilarious, and made it a comfortable environment to learn. Exams were decent, and as long as you paid attention to the HW, you'd do fine. Definitely would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hilarious, but his lectures are kinda hard to follow, especially with his messy handwriting. I find the midterms to be of reasonable difficulty, and he puts overall improvement as a factor into your final grade. Would highly recommend watching Carr's Math 208 lecture videos on Youtube over going to his lectures though.

Prof. Perkins is a very nice professor but his lectures can be hard to follow at times. His tests, at least midterm 2, were very difficult even though I put in a lot of hours of studying. As a math major, I think he is a good professor but I can see how people would find his teaching style to be frustrating. His exams would be my biggest complaint.
Would not take again. Very disorganized notes

He is quite the comedian, historian, and lecturer. Grades are based mostly on test performance. Homework is heavy as it would be for the calc series. If I could take another math course with him teaching, I definitely would.

Main grades come from the midterms and final, but there is still lots of hw. Lectures can be a bit confusing to follow as he'll stop a problem when he feels like you can solve it, but main explanation of new material is good. At least 2 hw sections a week, each around 12 problems with multiple parts. Weekly worksheets in quiz section are mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Friendly and laid-back. Pretty outdated/disorganized and just writes problems from other profs on torn-out notebook paper (dislikes new tech/methods except perhaps Gradescope). Barely any homework but exams are heavily weighted to grade. Tries to keep class from being bored with some personal stories or dry humor every once in a while.
Good professor. The concept is not hard. He uses many examples to explain these concepts. And the homework is all related to the lecture.

Very disorganized. Jumps from one topic to another so quickly and assumes to keep up with him. He only somewhat teaches the concept(not in depth) and assumes you are smart enough to understand the rest. Take him only if you are very good in math.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is great.

The homework can be tough and the lectures are extremely important if you want to go anywhere, but he goes on a number of hilarious tangents. His midterms are also by far the easiest in the entire department, but the final may burn some people as it is written by the entire department and as such significantly harder than one may be used to.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Perkins is a solid choice. The way the class is laid out means that tests significantly impact your grade, so do solid on them. There is a lot of homework but this is typical for the course. His lectures are good, and he takes time to break up topics by going onto tangents about his life. He is approachable and definitely willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The lectures were confusing and the textbook is worthless and out of date (80s). If you just review the practice exams, it's more helpful than anything he teaches. Homework was just doing simplex again and again by hand. Nothing was conceptually hard, this felt like an algebra 1 class. Perkins himself seems like a great guy but this class sucked.

The prof is hilarious, but the lectures are dry. The class is all about a single algorithm, that is applied repeatedly by hand throughout the quarter (think solving systems equations by hand). The conceptual/theoretical topics are only introduced in the last 2 weeks, and that's what the final is on. Grading: hw 100pts, midterm 100pts, final 150pts.

Professor Perkins is a really sweet guy, he's always willing to help out students and meet during office hours or after class. The class was hard but his lectures were helpful, and he is a funny guy which is a plus!

Perkins is a funny dude and makes the tests easy to understand. He wont try to trick his students with thought questions. However, he doesnt prepare students super well for the final (where all the math 124 profs collaborate). The amount of WebAssign homework is crazy, but that is for all of the MATH 124 classes

I really enjoyed Dr. Perkins lecture as he was funny and covers previous exam questions as examples. His lectures are a big unorganized but manageable. His previous exams are very helpful and he uses similar questions on his exams. He made class enjoyable just need to work hard. He doesnt curve tho and raises your grade based on improvement.
The class is good, the lectures are clear and insightful, there really isn't much else to say
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had Prof. Perkins for Spring 2020 so it was an online class. He didnt use zoom which made it hard to get to know him but he seems like a really nice guy. He does not accept late work, does not give extra credit, and doesnt allow test retakes so dont bother asking. He was easily accessible outside of class and used both Piazza and office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: The curve is so tough. He curves the class into having a median of 2.7, but as far as I know he could make the median at most 3.1. I don't know why he choose to curve the class so hard. Anyways, 98% overall corresponds to a 3.7. Also I only went to the lecture for the first tow weeks because his teaching sucks. Avoid this professor as you can.

I did not find the lectures engaging. It was very disorganized and all over the place, jumping from one topic to another and back to the same topic again. He is not clear when we are starting a new topic. I did poorly in this class despite putting in hours outside of class trying to learn by going to office hours and MSC. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's been teaching for about 40 years so he has polished lecturing skills. He doesn't post them, though, so show up. Get used to reading his hand writing lol it's a bit messy. His midterms are based on homework and some problems done in class. I couldn't make it to office hours so I just emailed him. Only thing you need is webassign.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: It's a weed out class and the standard for homework is already set by the department. His tests are always fair and if you go to class you will know what to expect on the tests. He's funny and will help you if you need help during office hours. The curve is tough but he will bump you out if your grade if you improve over the year. Fair professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In my opinion, Math126 is the hardest class I've taken so far because I have trouble visualizing and understanding things in 3-D. Dr. Perkins is a great guy, but not so much a great lecturer. His handwriting is messy and he doesn't post his notes online. You will need to read the textbook and practice midterm archives to pass this class.
He explains stuff pretty well in class and uses a lot of example problems. He's alright.

Ok professor does give weekly quizzes, 4 per quarter does drop one. Midterms are 50/50 final obviously worth more. His lectures are pen and paper, which organization can be an issue. If you do the work at home then you will be fine, Math 125, in general, is the hardest Calc Class in the series so don't sweat it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A mostly clear lecturer when it comes to teaching concepts, sometimes does go a bit off topic. Perkins is very clear about what is going to be on quizzes/midterms and they are very mechanical based/straight forward. If you read the book and do the practice problems alongside the homework, his class will be easy for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Super nice. If you go to OH he will learn your name. He goes on a lot of really random tangents in lectures (I kept a tally every lecture and he averages 6/class, fun fact), but it keeps things interesting. I noticed someone else said he doesn't finish examples sometimes he'll stop without simplifying the answer as he assumes we all know algebra.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: His midterms are so easy. He doesn't do panapto, so unless you have a friend in the class, you have to show up to lecture. But one thing I didn't like about him was that he has a slightly condescending attitude. He also goes off on tangents a lot... but, all in all, a great professor. In addition, he's a really funny guy and likes making jokes.
Absolutely awful! Do not take him; doesnt know how to lecture. Doesnt finish examples. Easy class, just use the textbook and do the homework
He's great

Perkins was a great prof to start out my time at UW! By far my favorite professor. He taught math exactly as how my teacher did in high school. Lectures consisted of a lot of practice problems, which was helpful to understand his thought process and what steps they are looking for on exams. Really enjoyed his teaching style and quirkiness.

Professor Perkins was a good professor to start math out with. His requirements for the class are clear. Try not to miss lectures, as he doesn't use Panopto or post his notes online. He was very charismatic and passionate about what he was teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He was great for my first math professor at the UW! Very approachable, fair grading, and entertaining during lectures. Be sure to take good notes though, as they aren't posted online. You do have to put in time outside of class but it's not impossible; I failed every quiz but still ended up above a 3.0

I love Perkins! He is a very straight forward teacher and is very honest about what will appear on the midterms and does not try and trick you. The only downside is that his lectures are not the greatest and I had to rely on my TA but he is a very funny guy. I wish I had him for the whole math series!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Had to drop this course because he did not teach the material well. Ended up teaching myself a lot of the course which resulted in bad test grades (theres only so much you can learn yourself). Lots of homework and is unclear what questions will appear on tests/quizzes
I really enjoyed this class. Mr. Perkins was funny and accessible. His tests are on the easier side but it will not matter because there is a curve so be prepared to work hard regardless.

Although it is only my 2nd quarter, Perkins has beat my other professors by a long shot. He's funny, insightful, witty, and makes lectures enjoyable. I took him in math 120 and am currently taking him for 124. His exams are very reasonable and he is always willing to help a struggling student if they seek help.

Some people didn't like his lectures and jokes but I thought they were great. Once you get used to his style, quizzes and exams are predictable and easy to study for. Easy to get help during office hours and by email. He's a lecturer not a professor so his only job is teaching and it shows that he cares about student learning.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Perkins has been my favorite professor at UW thus far. He is good at keeping the class engaged through a mix of math and stories. If you want to do well on tests take special note of the webassign problems gone over in class. The test will be very similar.

He's a really great guy, very funny. Sometimes gets off track during lectures. But overall lectures are helpful, and his office hours are also very helpful. Tests are way easier than other people. Overall, great!
Perkins is by far one of the funniest and weirdest professors I've taken a class with. Unfortunately, he isn't great at teaching, but as long as class material isn't too heavy, you should be fine.

Perkins is a generally nice person with plenty of funny stories to tell, but he often strays from the lecture materials and expects you to know a lot more than what he teaches you. Overall, he wasn't the worst but certainly not the best. He was very straightforward with what would be on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Had Perkins my first quarter @UW. He's doesn't have it out for his students. He's usually upfront with how many hard questions there will be on the midterms. IF YOU WORK ON THE PRACTICE MIDTERM EXAMS RIGHT AWAY, you'll get full points on all the quizzes and exams. He doesn't lecture well, but hey it's UW, Ostroff and Loveless are better, but...
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Nice guy. Great resource in office hours. His lectures are funny sometimes and he does a good job at making a dry subject somewhat interesting. His tests were tough and expectations weren't clearly defined. The average final grade was 90% so its incredible competitive to get a good grade
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Perkins told loads of really funny stories during lecture, but lecture wasn't actually that helpful. He seemed better at teacher if someone asked him a specific question.
My first math professor in college. HE IS AMAZING!!

Prof Perkins is a good guy and a fine teacher. The class is hard so you have to put in the effort to do well. If you don't dedicate yourself to this class you will not do well. Expect hours of homework, fine lectures, and tough tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's very reasonable and straightforward about the course material. At the beginning of the course, he will warn that the hardest part of the class is keeping track of all of the vocabulary, which is entirely true. Occasionally though he mentions the most random, hilarious things during lecture.

Definitely a difficult class if you've never taken calculus. I didn't use the textbook at all, attended lectures, have never taken calc, and got a 3.2. He's funny but not the most on topic at times. Overall his office hours are very helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Admittedly, Professor Perkins does not have the most focused lectures (he also expects you to be reading the text before class) but he goes over the homework and other tricky bits. Tells funny random stories. Office hours are great, he often stayed extra time to help out. Totally willing to help in any way he can.

Perkins speeds through the math section of lectures and uses the rest of the time to tell stories about math history or his time in Hawaii. His office hours are helpful and if you go one time he will remember your name. If you are struggling he's very supportive and cares about how you do. Perky P is a decent teacher and a great man.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Perkins is cool with a strange sense of humor, says random stories in class if math gets dry. He teaches you how to think and approach problems but doesn't give algorithms so had to learn some stuff from YouTube. Do webassign and past exams and you'll ace his class. Never went to OH so can't comment. If you talk to him, he'll memorize you name.

If you want a good professor, Perkins is that guy.  He's funny and will get you through math if you just pay attention and put in the work, everyone commenting negatively clearly feels a lecture should give you every answer to everything... not true. Your still have to work hard but Perkins is amazing. 10/10  He makes lectures fun and he's smart.
I really like this professor. Definitely a very good choice in Math department in U Dub.  Very Generous.
fav prof
informs on what to expect on exams. generous grader, tests are very hard

He's funny and entertaining but rambles a lot during lecture. Expect to teach yourself a lot of the material. A lot of homework but that's any math class. Very clear on what he expects on his exams. Doing the old exams online is very helpful, as he usually reuses those questions.

For someone whos not a Math person. Perkins did a good job of helping me through it. His grading is pretty generous. Alot of tedious hw and some quizzes.  2 midterms and a final. IF YOU WANT TO PASS DO ALL THE OLD EXAMS ONLINE. It will definitely help I promise you. They are very similar.
Perkins is one of the best professors I have ever had. His lectures are funny and helpful. Always their when you need him. Cares about the students. Highly recommend to sign up for his class!
super helpful!
Very helpful, if you express interest in the class he will help you. Tests are tough

His quizzes are out of 10 points. Midterms are tough. Rambles in lectures about his sister's goat and how he brews beer. He doesn't explain his thought process and assumes the students knows what he's doing. The TA isn't all that helpful either. "I don't come to class prepared, but I hope you're inspired to think on your toes too." -Prof. Perkins.

Lectures can be a bit confusing as he tends to go through his algebra very quickly. He really cares about his students and is willing to ignore bad homework grades/quiz grades as long as you can demonstrate you know the material. He wants you succeed and learn. Midterms are very difficult however he does tell you what problems to expect.
He will respond my e-mail immediately !

Dr. Perkins is a really good professor. He cares about his students and makes sure they understand what he's doing. However, his teaching is very unorganized and hard to follow along (sometimes). The tests are the hardest things I've ever done. Luckily he curved the score so mine wasn't too bad.

Perkins teaches as if it's simply a hobby of his, rather than an actual job. His tests are ridiculously tough and lectures leave you confused since he goes from step one to step 4 with out any explanation. He's a funky dude, but does not do well teaching an entry level calculus class.

During lecture, he does example problems but will only give you hints or shows you how to do part of the problem. Lectures are not helpful at ALL. His exams are extremely hard. Not even past midtermsfinals will help you prepare for his exams. If you can, AVOID TAKING THIS CLASS WITH HIM AT ALL COST.

I was scared by all the comments here before taking this class, yet it turned out that Dr Patrick is an amazing guy! His instructions are interesting and inspiring, and he got some tricks to make things easier. He is always there to help you. And, none of the tests are difficult, because he really did covered and explained all the knowledge needed.

This class was really hard for me. He grades on his own personal curve though, so you will do alright as long as you improve over the course of the quarter. He went on a lot of tangents during lecture which kept it interesting but it was hard to learn. He was unorganized but he really knows his stuff. He's a good prof but not super amazing.
Love him a lot  I got perfect score on this course. Go to every lecture and do your webAssign You will be fine!!  He is so nice and very glad to help his students.
No mercy on this guy's tests. Super hard grader and offers next to no partial credit. I wish I'd taken regular math because he curved this class way lower than Loveless ever did.

Perkins is a good professor. He's fair, grades on his own style curve (which helped me out), and has many entertaining anecdotes he likes to share in class. His lectures are clear and relevant, despite the difficulty of the course material. His tests are very difficult, however, a trait he shares with the rest of the math department at UW.
He tries to be funny, but he is not. Boring lecture and it is never relevant to homeworkexams. Ridiculously hard exams. I put in a lot of efforts, but did not succeed.

There are 2 non-cumulative midterms and 1 cumulative final in the quarter. His lectures are fantastic and interesting. He can make metaphors to help you understand stuff. I got a 3.8 with reasonable effort. Overall, he is a great professor, I would like to take his course again.

Perkins is a good math teacher, I'll give him that. His lectures are fast paced, so you'll mostly be copying notes from the screen and will have no time to actually absorb the material. However, his tests are really hard compared to other classes. I think he upped it this quarter too because our midterms were harder than his past Honors course's.

He's a fun guy in class and also teaches well. He is very helpful outside class and even with math outside the coursework. He spent a complete hour with me to help me out with a problem which I was solving to make a game for my side-project.
Used to want to be a math major back when I started this class in fall quarter. Not so much anymore.

Should have just taken Loveless... I heard from Loveless' students that he was so much more helpful and on top of things. Even though we were the honors class we ended up being behind Loveless' on the material and as a result our final grades suffered. Plus, Perkins trys to be funny during lecture which really detracts from the actual material.

Took Math 124H/125H/126H from him. Easy exams (from an honors student standpoint), so calculation mistakes can hurt your grade. Tells a lot of stories so the class gets behind the regular math classes. This results in him writing conceptually easier midterms than regular classes, but you'll have to try a bit for the math department written final.

took this class last quarter, really nice guy and tells funny stories but writes really hard tests. lectures were ok but he sidetracked way too much and the proofs were rather confusing. pretty hard grader- takes lots of points off for small errors. Better than Koblitz but take Loveless if you can. Nice guy, but not a great prof- nothing personal.

Received my worst grade up to this point; when I requested a regrade he took off two points on a midterm (which is huge). Lost 10 percent of a midterm grade because of a basic math error. Overall- funny in lecture but very disorganized which means that most of your learning will be up to you. Draconian grader and has a bad attitude in office hours.
Alright prof; makes really easy tests which means curves are unusually high for math department, so make sure you don't make stupid mistakes or choke up on tests.

Professor Perkins was a fairly knowledgable and nice person but I found his teaching style somewhat too relaxed and lazy. Despite studying lots before the test, I found tests were very difficult.. We covered the subjects on the test but they were amped up to 3x the difficulty. Nice guy but definitely felt like this was a "weed out" class.
Good professor and easy to follow along during his lectures. The material is easier than 124 and 125 but the test averages were also high. Definitely take his class if you can
His lecture is so disorganized, and not funny at all. He always told what to be on the test before the test day. Grading curve is very high.

I absolutely loved Perkins for math! He was super helpful and made sure to answer student questions clearly. Beware though, his exams are on the easier side so the curve is set pretty high. He's super funny and makes going to class a fun experience!!

I aced all quizzes & midterms and am expecting good grade on the final, so it's not a bad student whining. Perkins is funny during lectures but that doesn't make him a good professor. At least for me, I don't understand from his lectures. I learned entirely from the book and homework. His midterms are easy but he likes to test you on old materials.

Professor Perkins is a great teacher. He's very nice, and he knows his subject well. He is also very generous when it comes to grading on tests and quizzes, and his tests aren't extremely hard so long as you go to lecture and do the homework.

BEST MATH PROFESSOR. He is very clear during lecture (though sometimes gets sidetracked with his stories about Hawaii but they keep the class interesting) and is very clear on what he will be testing you on for exams (goes over what will be on tests.) He is a very fair grader (gives partial credit and understanding). Def. recommend him :):):):)

Hands down, Mr. Perkins is the best math professor I've had. He really doesn't like to make your life hard. He's quite an eccentric person, but sarcastic (in a good way) and very funny.  Explanations are crystal clear, quizzes and tests are easy if you went through the homework and worksheets, and grading is very fair.  I recommend going to his office hours. It helps a lot.
Rather humorous, gets sidetracked sometimes with his stories but they're entertaining

One of the best professors ever !! crystal clear, before any exam or quiz he displays the outline of it and makes his students aware of what they are expected to do. So fair, he DOESN'T LIKE to make your life harder, he knows his stuff really well and so so so helpful. So hilarious in class and has a great sense of humor
He has a great sense of humor~

Perkins is the PERFECT math professor. His explanations were so clear that I understood everything the first time he explained it. He tested us only on what he taught us in class, and before every midterm and final he would tell us exactly what would be the topics on the test. Best math professor ever! He's a really funny and nice person as well.

Perkins is awesome. His explanations are down to earth, and he really understand where the students are coming from. He's not cocky and arrogant like most math profs, and he has the most fair of quizzes and midterms. Homework load is fair as well. I freaking love this guy. Of all the math profs, get him! You wont regret it!
I LOVE HIM SOOOOOOOOOO MUCH. I'LL GET A BETTER GRADE ON SUCH ACTIVE CLASS.

He is GREAT! I mean, really really great. I like his teaching style. He makes math seem easy. He posts the grade online after first and second midterms so that everyone know where on the curve we are. Extremely recommended! His tests are ok too.
I FREAKING LOVE HIM!!!
YOU ARE SO EXERLENT

I wish I had him for Math 124-- he was a great lecturer in Math 120! Probably the best professor in the math department- very understanding- helpful in his office hrs- rewards you if you've shown improvement in the course when it comes down to your final grade.Perkins and Zhang are great professors.
really a great teacher.  always willing to teach in different ways and has a great anecdote for every situation.
He's, hands down, the best math professor I've ever had. He actually makes sense when he talks, and he's VERY patient :D
great teacher
Funny, Sarcastic, explains well but homework is difficult. Had him for 124 honors, he worked us hard but taught a lot! very good prof.
Really funny! Does a great job explaining the concepts and basics of calculus...so you actually know what you're doing.
Funny as hell. Great prof.
No Comments

Coming from Math125 w/ a very organized prof, I DID NOT enjoy Perkins' teaching style. His lectures seemed marginally linked to the actual homework & the material in 126 is HARD.He awards only 8 4.0's out of the whole class. Jokes aren't funny-tries too hard to be funny in my opinion. Not good at teaching the material-- in my opinion.
perkins is funny and sarcastic. his lectures are helpful, but somewhat unorganized. he tries to trick you on midterms and watch out for the true/false questions on the tests!

Interesting guy, he likes to tell stories that make the class better.  The math is HARD though, a lot harder then I was expecting.  Make sure to study and you should be ok.  So nice guy, but hard material, he does do a decent job at explaining it though.
Nice funny guy.  He did a pretty good job with the coursework.  He brags on himself a lot.
The stuff is all coming together, great professor with plenty of OK jokes.
Wow is this guy helpful and very eccentric.  I mean, who really talks about getting high on shrooms and teaching.  Great professor

He did not explain concepts well, in class was 90% of him asking students how they approached the clicker questions. Not very helpful, tests were hard but around the expected level of difficulty for the uw physics series.
He is nice, but his lectures/explanations are only okay. If you want to understand the concepts, you'll need to study them outside of class. Lectures are mostly for review and practice problems.

He is a very nice professor, but his teaching is average. His explanations lack the necessary depth to really understand the concepts. 122 is hard, so in comparison, he does fine. It helps to study in groups or with a buddy.

girl this was my first quarter at UW so i cut myself some slack but phys122 was incredibly difficult (math, logic, all of it). buat was a good professor esp compared to the others; he always answered questions and he was very nice (chill guy). i had a nice lab group but i would rec finding a person/few ppl for lectures (i braved through this alone)

Quentin is a great person and super chill, however is lectures are not very useful. The homework is practically all busy work. Expect to learn the most from tutorials, labs, and the readings as they contain the most important information. If you haven't taken AP Physics 1 expect to struggle a bit. But with a bit of studying it gets much easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Nah who is giving him 5 stars? I admit I don't like physics but his lectures were absurd! His French accent made it literally worse. When we asked questions his explanations doesn't help at all. Physics textbook itself is absurd but his lectures makes it more confusing. I survived this course by the help with TAs not him.

Any physics class is not going to be great, but Buat is a great teacher. He is very understanding, and I think his class is pretty reasonable. Again, I had a hard time and I was not too fond of the experience, but its physics so that is kind of how it goes. Tests are hard, and lectures are not too helpful. Reading is good and HW is reasonable.

Prof Buat was a great teacher for physics.  His lectures are thorough, he makes an effort for students and he helped increase my curiosity for physics.  The homework may be difficult but this is the case regardless of the prof.  Highly recommend Quentin Buat as a professor for 121 and hopefully he teaches other physics classes in the future.

Prof Buat has great slides for lecture and is accessible (answers questions after class, emailed workings for lecture HWs when I had a question). He's pretty quiet in the lecture hall but kept hybrid access to lecture (on Zoom) throughout the quarter which was very nice. The class is def hard and there are a lot of assignments to keep track of.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Lots of indiv assignments due beginning of the weeks
Heavy accent and a little quiet, but overall good at explaining material 
Seems like he cares a lot about how his students do
Lots of office hrs you can go to (TA or his)
Tests are fair (only hard bc physics is hard lol)
Poll questions are part of grade, so recommend going to class

Sarah is one of my favorite professors I've had at UW. She's a really engaging lecturer, is very approachable and kind, and clearly wanted us to learn. Theory is a bit dense, but everything I learned in her class has continued to help me rethink the world around me. If she's teaching theory, I say to take it :).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Three papers in total and two tests, as well as weekly annotations for each week that did not make sense which are called persuall comments. Honestly in comparison to all the other SOC 316 professors this professor had us doing too much work that was not manageable with all our other work.

Took her College Edge course ARTSCI 161 A Au 25: Social Sciences Seminar (Racial Capitalism and the City). Loved her and the material, she's very open minded, flexible, great at teaching the material, and selected great readings for the class. You can tell she cares about the learning aspect rather than just focusing on grades, I def learned a lot.
Very long lectures, three papers, and weekly discussion posts are required. Overall, a straightforward course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Love love love her. She so sweet and amazing. I had her for college edge and it was her first time teaching for the program and she was amazing! She's caring, understanding, and funny. She was always willing to listen and was overall an amazing prof. to be around!

She hopes to help you solve this course in the simplest way. there are cheat sheet for exams. Recording lecture and no attendance.The well-organized course content makes it easy for me to review. The professor and TA are willing to solve problems you encounter.she wants you to truly learn something rather than being overly strict about your work.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty simple class, I wish I went more but it was in the fishery building which is out of her control. She's very knowledgeable about what she's teaching and always happy to answer extra questions. She obviously cares about her class and definitely wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Quinn is passionate about the topics she teaches which makes her lectures (even 2 hour lectures) easy to sit through. Attendance isnt mandatory but she occasionally has in-lecture activities that are graded. Shes an approachable professor and is really understanding. I would definitely recommend this class to a friend.

You definitely won't be bored in lectures. Sarah Quinn is super open to feedback, and she is extremely honest and enthusiastic in her teaching. She makes her students understand why she's so passionate about sociology, and it's wonderful. Not a hard grader and is very understanding to any situations.

She is really enthusiastic, and uses plenty examples. I enjoyed coming to class, and it was relatively easy. You can skim the coursebook for a passing grade, I skimmed and I got above average on the exams & papers. She does say that student answers are a possibility which may cost you a point on the exam because there was a specific answer.

Lecture designed to be discussion-oriented, but instructor does not clarify which student answers are correct. Everyone is "right" for participating. Exam questions based on "discussions" that lack clear answers and direction. Readings are ultra-dense. Midterm class average was 60% and instructor did not curve or offer more than 1 point of EC.
Really enthusiastic and easy to talk to. By the end of the quarter everyone was comfortable speaking in class.

Ok she definitely assigns way too much work and readings and I hated how her class was arranged. BUT she gives a lot of extra credit. If you end up stuck in a class with her just do as much extra credit as you can and it'll help boost your grade if you miss any classes/tank an assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I find many criticism about Dr. Pearce's harsh grading unfair. She has messy and strict grading rubrics. If you follow them carefully, you'll be fine. But the real issue I think is in her pedagogy. I don't think she wants to teach. She hates it, and it shows. She hides behind AI to do most of her job, while the Department allows her keep going.
DO NOT TAKE AT ALL COSTS

I took this class a year ago and still think about it to this day. This was the most nightmarish class I have ever taken, and I have never come this close to failing a class in my life. Truly not worth it at all, just take a class with a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: UW knows how bad of a teacher she is but does not do anything about it because she does research which boosts the schools prestige. come on.

Nightmare professor. Have never experienced such a holier than thou person teaching a classroom. She teaches by her standards and sets expectations that are hard to meet. Flipped classroom means you will be dedicating 20+ hours a week to studying and still not passing her BS exams and quizzes. I wouldn't even subject my worst enemy to this class.

Very passionate and interesting topic matter, however I have never put in so much effort in a class to not even gain credit in my major. The grading was insanely harsh and seemed completely unfair. No matter how hard you try, it seems nearly impossible to get a decent grade. Felt like a complete waste of my tuition money.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Harsh critic, even harsher as a person. Shows immense bias, maybe some racism. Reports a lot of students for wrong conducts.

I have never met someone more undeserving of being called a ‘professor.' Before taking her class, I saw that her ratings were abysmal, but ignored it like a fool. 95% of the course material is AI-generated. Endless readings, constant quizzes, zero flexibility. I truly hope the department reconsiders this hire and replaces her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Pearce's COM 303 course is intriguing, fascinating, and includes some of my favorite topics within the field of Communications. She is always responsive regarding emails, always on-time to lectures, and clear with her standards in the class. Her systems for conducting her class are smooth throughout the quarter.

The workload is actually insane for an undergrad class, and she grades harshly. My group got back a draft which we worked our asses off on, with our google doc crashing because of how many annotations there were. And she was expecting citations for nearly every single sentence, the whole thing revised within a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Never have I taken a class where I hated a professor so quickly. She's notorious for sending students to academic misconduct and is the toughest grader known to mankind. If you try to email her, she likely won't respond unless you spam her, and she's very strict. Protect your peace and don't take this class; if not, you'll risk losing your sanity.

The dumbest profession I have ever met, giving impossible amounts of writing work during class group activity. She doesn't have homework; all the grades come from the weekly quiz on the 10 or more long scientific articles that she assigned. If you failed those quizzes, then you are cooked; there is no way to save your grade. Just stay away from her
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Worst class I've ever taken. I have never experienced a brick-wall persona like her. I maintained adequate communication and worked for hours on the assignments for her to quite literally offer no substantial feedback. Do not ever take her class she will dramatically decrease your zest for life.
The most generic, useless, and unnecessary feedback of all time. Harsh grader and even worse at explaining and setting clear guidelines.

Avoid COM407 with her. Grading is harsh and inconsistent. She uses Hypothesis for annotations and Sherpa for interviews but penalizes you for being too structured or not aligning with her views. Expectations are contradictory, and there's no clear rubric. Even well-prepared answers get marked down. The class is more frustrating than it's worth.

Please do not take! You will spend hours on the assignments and she will mark off everything. She has a flipped classroom and expects you to do and learn everything outside of class. The class activities are wasteful and graded harshly. She is condescending and acknowledges students are not doing well but never that it could possibly be her fault.
Feels like she doesn't actually teach because she uses SO much AI. Doesn't give real feedback, all AI. Why am I paying for this class lol.

I strongly believe that the UW should address the multiple negative reviews on Prof. Pearce. Even if it seems like only the most passionate people would write a negative review, the difference between Professor Pearce's RMP and the other Communication professors at UW is concerning.

SO much writing despite not being writing credit. Insanely harsh grader, accuses her students of using AI yet every slide she uses is AI-generated. Passive aggressive and treats her students like children. AVOID

Pearce grades harshly, it's nearly impossible to get 100% on anything; but, she clearly cares about her students' learning and provides very interesting content. Readings are long and dense. Inverted classroom - lots of reading outside, then group work in class. People on here are upset about their lack of effort coinciding with their poor grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: While I do agree that the grading is harsh, the oppurtunities for extra credit make up for it. I have found her to be a fair professor, if a little stricter than most. She does use AI all the time and then get mad when you use it and is really strict on deadlines so take my compliments with a grain of salt. Maybe not worth 70 1-star reviews tho.

Katy Pearce is undoubtedly the worst professor I've come across during my time at UW. It's unfortunate that a class that talked about interesting concepts were tainted with 10+ hours spent on reading every week, a grading standard that's inconsistent/abnormally high, and a professor that accuses you of using AI in your work. DONT TAKE HER CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I promise you, you don't want to take this class. Even if you like the topic and even if you need it for graduation. Katy Pearce is the kind of professor that truly needs to be addressed by the UW but clearly hasn't been for years, regardless of her awful reviews and overall performance. STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS!

Genuinely cannot believe this professor has not been addressed by the UW yet. Worst professor I have ever had in my entire college career and will grade you down for anything she can find. DO NOT take this class!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have ever had. Barely explains assignments and then grades harshly. Save yourself the mental breakdown!!

If you take this class after reading all these reviews, don't say you weren't warned. I usually feel bad writing these but this class was so horrible I had to make an exception. So many readings and in-class graded writing tests, and huge group project worth 40 percent of the final grade that is graded incredibly harshly. Stay away from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Katy Pearce is a stain on this great university. I have never met a worse teacher in my life. She does not care if her students pass or fail, she gives advice and then marks you down for doing what she recommended, she's not clear with her instructions, and she's just flat out rude. Katy Pearce should not have a job teaching anywhere.

This is the only professor I have ever disliked and I don't just dislike her, I hate her. The workload is unreasonable, the grading is ridiculously hard (I'm talking 60% average on the final rough draft), and the teacher is condescending and childish. It's insane that the communications department hasn't fired her yet.
I am in disbelief after this class. Never have I had a professor who grades and gives feedback like this. Not worth the time and effort, if you take this class you will see why. Save yourself.

All the reviews are true. Dr. Katy clearly cares about her subject and is knowledgable, but is HORRIBLE when it comes to teaching. She makes things oddly personal and her feedback comes out always as condescending and rude and never uplifting. Her grading is not concise which leaves you questioning your abilities. STAY AWAY FROM THIS CLASS!

Trust the reviews on here, SERIOUSLY. Content and lectures are interesting, yet somehow the class itself is awful.
